Axiom:
CSS module selectors follow the data-attribute pattern consistently: - `.btn[data-size="s"]` for size-dependent styles. - `.btn[data-mode="primary"][data-appearance="accent"]` for mode × appearance combinations. - `.btn[data-state="hover"]` for state-dependent styles. - Child elements use class selectors: `.icon`, `.label`, `.counter`, `.indicator`.
No ID selectors, no tag selectors (except `:root` in tokens), no descendant selectors deeper than 2 levels. Every selector is scoped to the component's root class (`.btn`).
